prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints consistently drove winning tests, whereas hints on other steps showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Desktop hotkey setup screens, guide screens, and quick-action redesigns on the finish step were consistently helpful.
Wait-stage info and waiting progress updates produced wins on home and adoption steps, though several showed no clear effect.
Layout modifications and copy updates consistently showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most other new screens and flows showed no clear effect or hurt performance, occasionally causing early test stops due to negative impact.
Predictions underestimated gains for finish-step hotkey and quick-action improvements while overestimating gains for ineffective changes.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Cloud Pet Restore Hint: Display a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in restores all previously adopted pets and cloud progress. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in. Lessons show sign-in hints consistently drive winning tests.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Preparation Status Info: Display explicit status info and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets initialize. (why: Home step waiting time reaches a median of 201s and mean of 2336s. Lessons show wait-stage info on the home step improves retention.)
2: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Customization Trait Processing Wait Info: Add progress updates and estimated wait time during photo upload processing. (why: Adoption step has a 65.2% conversion rate with long tail wait times (mean 1017s) and failed custom generation reports. Lessons note wait-stage info helps adoption steps.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Multi-Device Account Sync Hint: Show a clear reassurance hint during sign-in stating that pets sync automatically across all user devices. (why: Addresses account support emails regarding lost pets after re-signing in. Sign-in hints are proven high performers in previous tests.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Interaction Setup Flow: Insert a short interactive setup flow at the end of onboarding for practicing basic pet controls. (why: Multiple support emails asked how to control or minimize pets after setup. Finish step interaction features are consistently effective according to test lessons.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready System Notification: Enable desktop system notifications when background pet rendering finishes during the waiting screen. (why: Home wait time has a mean of 2336s. System notifications allow users to safely switch windows without missing when their pet is ready.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Security and Pet Memory Hint: Add sign-in copy confirming that user accounts safely retain pet personality data and certificate records. (why: 8 support emails cited reset pet data after signing in. Lessons show sign-in reassurance hints consistently drive winning test results.)

scores.note: Sign-in hints consistently drive winning tests (+1.9% historical average).
Wait-stage info on home step effectively addresses severe wait time dropoff.
Targets largest funnel bottleneck (34.8% loss) with high historical test lift (+5.3%).
Low cost hint addressing verified user sync support issues with proven gain.
New flows and screens tend to hurt conversion (-1.5% historical average) and carry high dev cost.
Desktop notifications re-engage users during long background initialization (+2.2% lift).
Low risk text change addressing data loss concerns based on strong historical wins.
